stop_conditions: Error root cause in order-service (or its postgres/redis dependency) is identified with logs/traces showing a specific failing operation
order-service error_pct drops below ~5% and gateway error_pct returns to near baseline
Trace of a failing POST /checkout shows non-error spans through gateway and order-service
Evidence budget exhausted or same hypothesis confirmed by two independent sources (logs + trace)
initial_hypotheses: order-service is the error epicenter: 93-97.5% HTTP errors and gateway spans propagate 502/500 from POST /checkout
gateway errors are secondary amplification of downstream order-service failures rather than a gateway-internal fault
order-service dependency (postgres/redis/inventory) or its shared pool is causing checkout failures while inventory-service HTTP remains clean
notification-service rps increase (2/min) is benign Redpanda consumer traffic, not a cause
